fact: The 2025 figures (13 596 869 learners in 24 766 ordinary public and independent schools, Grades 1-7 and 8-12 tabulated) are from databases uploaded on LURITS and the provincial data warehouses as at July 2025, and approximately 99.9% of functional ordinary schools were uploaded; this is a share of all ordinary schools uploading a learner database, not a share of primary schools entering attendance or results.
title: School Realities 2025
